A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–F. Complete text and visual comparisons support reliable assessment.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendix F report original evaluations of prototypical neurosymbolic models on MNIST-EvenOdd, Kand-Logic, and BDD-OIA, including baseline comparisons and ablations.

after.justification: Section 6 and Appendix F retain those original model evaluations, numerical results, and ablations.

M1.justification: The prototype construction, distance-based predictions, losses, and unlabelled-centroid initialization are retained. Algorithm 1 removes an empty loop and corrects a mean subscript; these repair its documentation without changing the described training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use MNIST-EvenOdd, Kand-Logic, and BDD-OIA with the same task coverage, including restricted-support testing and scenarios with unlabelled concept classes.

E2.justification: The corresponding main-text and appendix comparisons retain DPL, SL, LTN, CCN+, and ABL, together with the same pretraining, supervision, reconstruction, entropy, and disentanglement variants.

E3.justification: Data splits, support sizes, augmentations, metrics, training budgets, architectures, and RQ1–RQ5 evaluation procedures are unchanged. Appendix E corrects malformed class-index notation without reporting a different sampling design.

E4.justification: The analyses of unlabelled-data fractions, hidden classes, centroid initialization, and disentanglement are retained. Confusion matrices and the BDD-OIA examples in the appendices provide the same supplementary evidence.

E5.justification: Appendix E lists the same ten seeds, and RQ4 retains five repetitions with randomly selected hidden classes. The uncertainty entries, plotted bands, and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results, plotted curves, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and Appendix F. For example, Table 1 retains DPL+PNet F1(C) of 0.96±0.04, and Table 3 retains its BDD-OIA F1(C) of 0.16±0.15.

T1.justification: Theorem 4.1, Corollary 4.2, Proposition 5.1, their assumptions, and the proofs in Appendices A–C are unchanged. Section 3 removes inconsistent concept-domain qualifiers and restores H_i subscripts for the existing per-class construction; these are notation corrections rather than revised mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about mitigating reasoning shortcuts through prototype grounding with scarce labels, explaining embedding updates, reducing deterministic shortcuts under assumptions, and validating on three tasks.

C2.justification: The explanations of prototype grounding, hidden-class sensitivity, and concept-versus-label performance remain unchanged. Appendices D and F retain the same discussion of BDD-OIA imbalance, noisy labels, and missing temporal or contextual information.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 removes a dangling empty loop and corrects its centroid-mean subscript. Appendix E repairs the BDD-OIA support-selection condition to j ≠ j′. These are limited documentation corrections; hyperparameters, hardware, software disclosures, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The bibliography and research positioning are retained. Section 7 replaces awkward wording about avoiding shortcuts, without changing its characterization of prior work or adding citations.

P1.justification: v2 updates Luca Andolfi's affiliation and email, capitalizes occurrences of Prototypical Neurosymbolic terminology, and makes spelling, punctuation, and local wording corrections. The section and appendix organization remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Several PNet row labels become bold in Tables 8 and 10. Caption capitalization, the shortened Algorithm 1 display, and local text reflow also change. No figures or tables are added or removed, and their plotted content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1, v2 removes the dangling loop in Algorithm 1 and corrects centroid and support-selection notation, reducing avoidable ambiguity in the method documentation. Small language and table-formatting corrections also improve consistency. The empirical evidence and theoretical arguments remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to technical clarity and presentation.
